Suggested Action: Approve recommendation. 2. 24-53504 Recommendation to discuss the agenda for the Parks and Recreation Commission meeting of June 20, 2024. Suggested Action: Approve recommendation. PUBLIC COMMENT Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission Executive Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair. ADJOURNMENT I, Christine Amaya, Administrative Aide, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Parks, Recreation and Marine Administration Office at (562) 570-3110.
